# Purpose
This file defines the `FD_METRICS_BUNDLE` metadata table for the bundle metrics set. It includes counter, gauge, and histogram entries for bundle events such as transaction receipt, packet receipt, bundle receipt, errors, heap usage, keepalives, connection state, and RTT values. The `DECLARE_METRIC_ENUM` entries define separate error counters for each `BUNDLE_ERROR` value, including `PROTOBUF`, `TRANSPORT`, `TIMEOUT`, `NO_FEE_INFO`, and `SSL_ALLOC`. The file is generated by `gen_metrics.py`, so it serves as a build-time data source and must not be edited by hand.
